index_id.description: Stable identifier for this closeout index series (updates may chain via previous_index_sha256).

index_version.description: Schema version of this index payload.

generated_at.description: When this index payload was generated (best effort).

expected_set_sha256.description: Optional digest of the bytes that define the expected reporting-unit set (roster) used for completeness evaluation.

previous_index_sha256.description: Optional digest of the previous index payload in this series, for rollback/rewrites detection.

reporting_unit_id.description: Precinct/reporting-unit identifier as used by the jurisdiction.

custody_anchor_sha256.description: Optional digest anchoring the jurisdiction's physical ballot custody chain for this reporting unit (e.g., scanned chain-of-custody packet, seal log bundle).

closeout_packet_manifest_sha256.description: Digest of the referenced closeout micro-packet manifest.json bytes.

closeout_notice_sha256.description: Optional digest of the PublicNotice envelope that announced this closeout packet (if available).

mirrors.description: Optional mirror URLs/URIs where the closeout packet can be fetched.

status.description: Optional status hint. Operator-issued indexes typically use 'published'; watcher-issued indexes may include 'missing'/'late'.

notes.description: Optional short note about this entry (avoid narratives).
Optional short notes for operators/observers (avoid narratives).
